timeline.Description: Take a vehicle to Noi Bai International Airport. Fly from Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh City, landing at Tan Son Nhat International Airport.

TransportOptions.Pros: Fastest for long distances, most comfortable, time-saving
TransportOptions.Cons: Most expensive, airport transfers needed, security checks, weather dependent

timeline.Description: Take a vehicle to Ga Ha Noi. Take a train from Hanoi to Da Nang, arriving at Ga Da Nang.

TransportOptions.Pros: Comfortable, scenic views, can move around, reliable schedule
TransportOptions.Cons: Fixed schedule, may be delayed, limited routes
